title: A Survey on Automatic Online Hate Speech Detection in Low-Resource Languages
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hate speech, discrimination, and stereotyping targeted at individuals or groups based on their religion.
findings: The survey identifies religious hate speech as a key category for detection, with specific datasets available, such as for Arabic religious hate speech and Islamophobia. However, research is more focused on the general problem of hate speech in low-resource languages, with religion being one of several targeted characteristics. The complexity and ambiguity of defining and annotating religious hate speech remain significant challenges for automated systems.
